title: Ecology federal permits record: Sacks Dock Replacement and Expansion (Aquatics 10119)

licence.text: Use allowed with credit and a link; commercial and political use prohibited

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: 2024 - The applicant proposes to remove an existing ramp and float and install a new ramp and float in Deer Harbor on Orcas Island, San Juan County, Washington. The proposed structure would be 270.5sf larger than the existing footprint. The existing ramp and float currently extend to -10 mean lower low water (MLLW) and are oriented south. The proposed structure would extend deeper into navigable waters to -20 MLLW and the float would be reoriented to face north. All four chains and five-foot diameter concrete anchors currently stabilizing the structure would be removed and replaced with four 12-inch diameter steel piles. The existing pier structure would remain onsite, and no work is proposed.
